remarks: RARE CUSTOM BUILT SOUTHERN STYLE CAPE w/Ranch Style Living on 3/4 acre! Truly a RARE FIND! Distinctive character, EXCEPTIONAL CRAFTSMANSHIP & convenience of primarily 1st floor living w/2 bedrooms on lower & 2 bedrooms on upper feature fully upgraded baths! Large bedrooms feature deep closets, built-ins, storage & fresh carpet (currently 1 bedrm used an office) Situated along a Private Road with only 6 homes on the Court, this one-of-a-kind property offers privacy, space, history & versatile just outside the Village. With over 2800 ft.², this 4 bedroom plus BONUS efficiency apartment offers triple entries & flexible living for family & guests. An inviting front porch features separate entrances serving for both main residence & in law studio apartment. Rich in local history, the land is said to be the site associated with the original Erie County Fair & Racetrack from yesteryear in the early 1900’s! Remarable Stone & Rock are believed to have been brought in from the Adirondacks via the Erie Canal! While Rich in Historical significance, the property is not located within the Historical District. Inside, a spacious foyer welcomes you to a Living/Dining area flowing into an impressive Open Concept Great Room w/floor to ceiling windows bringing in the outdoors, flanked by soaring vaulted tongue & groove ceilings, gas fireplace & mega built-in’s. Kitchen features Cherry Cabinetry, solid pocket door, build in spice rack, pantry, solid surface countertops & newer built an appliances. New Pella 8 foot slider opens directly to the freshly painted deck, Gazebo & concrete Patio w/partially fenced yard. Landscaped grounds have beautiful mature trees: Dappled Willow, Silver Maples, Northern Catalpa, Crab Apple & more! An oversized 2.5 car side load garage provides double entry to basement & abundant parking! Improvements added: Lennox Boiler 2026, Roof 2021, Pella Windows, 4 new Storm doors, Solar tube lighting, Generator, HWT & Sump Pump 2014, Basement Waterproofing & Blacktop Driveway Sealed 2026, 200 AMP Electrical Service, 1st floor A/C w/additional wall unit upstairs. An EXCEPTIONAL PROPERTY with a Story of its Own!! Offers reviewed as received. NEW PRICE!
